vo_face_upper_taper_full_perimeter.evidence: At thumbnail scale, long side locks cross both temple-to-cheek boundaries, so the full upper-width transition is not unobscured.

vo_face_upper_taper_vertical_relation.evidence: At thumbnail and native scale, the central hairline-to-chin span and upper-face breadth remain readable together in the frontal view.

vo_face_upper_taper_width_hierarchy.evidence: At thumbnail and native scale, the exposed forehead and upper-temple skin span is visibly broader than the mandibular angle span.

vo_face_upper_taper_continuous_chin.evidence: The native crop shows both lower cheeks narrowing smoothly through a smaller jaw into a compact narrow chin, rather than only an isolated pointed tip.

vo_face_upper_taper_confound_control.evidence: The native crop shows anatomical skin boundaries under even frontal light; iconography, makeup, shadow, and lens distortion do not carry the width hierarchy, while hair occlusion is separately failed above.

technical_verdict.reason: The strict five-gate set is not fully satisfied because hair masks the upper perimeter transition.
